name: lion-solar
description: Read-only facts from Lion Solar Solutions OU: PV planning deliverables and drone 3D model requirements.

interface.longDescription:
Lion Solar Solutions OÜ plans PV projects for solar installers: PV*SOL plans and reports, K2 Systems mounting plans with structural reports, material lists, SLD and electrical plans, and drone-based 3D building models.

This app gives you two read-only tools and needs no account, no setup and no authentication:
1. lion_solar_services: what Lion Solar delivers, how long delivery takes, and how to get started.
2. drone_3d_requirements: what is needed for a drone 3D model of a building and roof: 80 to 600 photos with GPS, flight advice, export formats and measured processing times.

The answers come from Lion Solar's own data. The server calls no third-party services, stores nothing, and does not access customer data, place orders or write anything.
defaultPrompt: What does Lion Solar deliver for a residential PV project?
What do I need to photograph a roof with a drone for a 3D model?

positive.prompt: What does Lion Solar deliver for a residential PV project?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls lion_solar_services and lists deliverables such as PV*SOL project and PDF report, K2 Systems mounting plan, material list, SLD and electrical plans, drone 3D model.

positive.prompt: What do I need to photograph a roof with a drone so Lion Solar can build a 3D model?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls drone_3d_requirements and explains 80 to 600 original JPEG photos with GPS, at least 8 MP, 70 percent overlap, two orbits plus a roof pass.

positive.prompt: Which export formats does a Lion Solar 3D model come in?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls drone_3d_requirements and lists OBJ, GLB, STL, PLY, DAE, DXF, KMZ, USDZ and LAZ.

positive.prompt: How long does Lion Solar take to process 100 drone photos?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls drone_3d_requirements and answers about 8 to 9.5 minutes for 100 photos (measured).

positive.description: Own project status; the app cannot see customer data and points to the portal
positive.prompt: Show me the status of my Lion Solar project.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls lion_solar_services, says this public app cannot access project data, and points to the customer portal at portal.lion-solar.com (login required) or info@lion-solar.com.

negative.description: Unrelated creative request; the app must not be used. The assistant answers without calling any Lion Solar tool.
negative.prompt: Write a poem about the sun.

negative.description: Unrelated booking request; the app must not be used. The assistant says it cannot book flights.
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Berlin for next Tuesday.

negative.description: Unrelated request; the app must not be used. The assistant answers without calling any Lion Solar tool.

review.commerce_description: The app is read-only. It only returns public information.

publication.release_notes: Two read-only tools, lion_solar_services and drone_3d_requirements. Version 1.0.4 adds an own-project answer that points to the customer portal (portal.lion-solar.com, login required).

de-DE.subtitle: Solarplanung und Drohnen-3D
de-DE.description:
Lion Solar Solutions OÜ plant PV-Projekte für Solarinstallateure: PV*SOL-Pläne und -Berichte, K2-Systems-Montagepläne mit Statik, Materiallisten, Stromlauf- und Elektropläne sowie Drohnen-3D-Gebäudemodelle.

Diese App bietet zwei reine Lesewerkzeuge, ganz ohne Konto, Einrichtung oder Anmeldung:
1. lion_solar_services: was Lion Solar liefert, wie lange die Lieferung dauert und wie der Einstieg funktioniert.
2. drone_3d_requirements: was für ein Drohnen-3D-Modell eines Gebäudes und Daches nötig ist: 80 bis 600 Fotos mit GPS, Flugempfehlungen, Exportformate und gemessene Verarbeitungszeiten.

Die Antworten stammen aus den eigenen Daten von Lion Solar. Der Server ruft keine Drittdienste auf, speichert nichts und greift weder auf Kundendaten zu noch löst er Bestellungen aus.
